findings.problem: Value 'A1-R with W-2s, due Jan 31 (30-day extension for good cause)'. The only local source with a 30-day extension is the ADOR filing-obligations page (US-AZP52-005, employer-withholding-filing-obligations_wayback.html): 'Employers may apply for a 30-day extension of time to file Arizona Form A1-APR'. A1-APR is the annual payment return, not A1-R. A.R.S. 43-412 (US-AZS5-022, the cited row) says only 'The department may extend the filing deadline on a showing of good cause'. As written, the rule gives A1-R filers a 30-day extension that no source grants.
findings.expected: 'A1-R with W-2s, due Jan 31 [US-AZS5-025 Pub. 701]; the department may extend the deadline on a showing of good cause [US-AZS5-022]'. Keep the 30-day extension only on A1-APR [US-AZP52-005] if that return is in scope. Rebuild.

findings.problem: These are regressions from the r2 rebuild that the regression guard does not explain. The generator takes Authority, channel and portal from the first cited row, so re-pointing citations changed their meaning. (a) WC-001 D29: the Authority of the Washington State-fund report changed from 'Washington State Department of Labor & Industries' to 'Washington State Legislature (Code Reviser)', and the J29 portal is now the RCW 51.16.140 page. (b) DOR-002 G61/J61 PA: the channel changed from 'file_upload (myPATH)' to 'paper (myPATH)', although the fact makes myPATH mandatory at 10 or more income statements. (c) DOR-002 G53/J53 ND: 'online_form, api (TAP)' was dropped and the 'portal' is now a guideline PDF. (d) DOR-002 J40 IN: the 'portal' is now the EFW2 guide PDF.
findings.expected: Take Authority and portal from the filing (scope_manifest / crosswalk, or a per-State portal map), not from the legal-basis row. WC-001 D29 = Washington State Department of Labor & Industries. PA channel = file_upload (myPATH), paper only below 10 statements. ND channel and portal = the r1 values (TAP), unless a source says otherwise. IN portal = INTIME. Add a regression-guard rule: any change in Report Matrix columns D, G or J needs an explicit reason.

findings.problem: The reason says 'Federal EFW2 is a fixed-width SSA specification with no published validator schema'. The exemption's own source (26efw2.pdf; local copy FED_SSA_EFW2_TY2026_Pub42-007_2026-11-02.pdf, sec. 6.0, p. 82) documents an authority validator: 'AccuWage Online is a free internet application offered by SSA that enables you to check EFW2 ... and EFW2C ... formatted wage files for format correctness'. It requires a BSO User ID with the Employer Services profile. MANDATE US-MQ-11 also names 'SSA AccuWage for EFW2' and 'IRS MeF schemas for 94x'. The owner's default decision therefore rests on a false premise: the real limitation is credentialed access, not the absence of a validator.
findings.expected: Reword the reason: 'SSA AccuWage Online validates EFW2/EFW2C but requires a BSO account (Employer Services profile) that the pipeline does not hold; IRS MeF 94x schemas are distributed only to authorised e-file providers; no national validator for State formats; FL RT XSD and MI MiUI held but not wired'. Update US-OWN-010 to match and have the owner re-confirm. The scaffolder makes the edit, not the auditor. The SKIP may stand once the reason is true.
